hypothesis: Order-flow imbalance (share of each hour's volume that was aggressive taker buying) carries POSITIVE directional information at 1h-24h; trade intensity (trades per hour vs its recent average) carries magnitude information and no clear direction. Expected signs stated in advance.
acceptance_criterion: PRE-REGISTERED before running. Direction: Spearman(feature, return_H) block-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero with the same sign in BOTH exploration and validation. Magnitude: same, plus |rho| >= 0.10 both periods.

availability_check.source: Binance spot 1h klines fields 8 (number of trades) and 9 (taker buy base volume), 2017-08-17 ->, snapshot data/klines_extra_btcusdt_1h_2026-09-20.csv; validated (taker-buy volume never exceeds total volume, no negatives)
availability_check.point_in_time_rule: part of the closed candle (complete at the cutoff)
availability_check.unavailable: order-book depth, bid/ask spread, liquidity: no free history

feature_version: microstructure v1: taker_buy_share_1h/6h/24h, trades_rel_24h, trades_rel_168h (the hour is excluded from its own baseline)

target.definition: signed forward return (direction) and absolute forward return (magnitude)
target.outcome: close of candle opening at as_of+H

point_in_time: 5 tests in tests/test_microstructure_features.py (known values, baseline excludes current hour, gap blanking, garbled-future)

magnitude_passes.trades_rel_24h: consistent positive at 1-72h, below the floor in exploration (0.04-0.09)

metrics.per_year_24h: taker-buy share direction flips sign year to year at 24h (no 24h effect); the 1-6h effect is not broken down by year in this harness

results: DIRECTION: the hypothesis was WRONG in sign, and the opposite is consistent. Hours dominated by aggressive buying are followed by slightly LOWER returns over the next 1-6 hours, in both periods, with intervals excluding zero (|rho| 0.02-0.05). This is the third appearance of the same short-horizon reversal family (E002 momentum and volume; E003 interaction) -- real, consistent, and too small to build a signal on alone. MAGNITUDE: trade intensity relative to the prior week strongly predicts the size of the next 1-6h move (rho 0.17-0.30), a second uncertainty input alongside recent volatility (E003); their overlap must be measured when the uncertainty model is built.
consistent_across_time: Direction (1-6h reversal): consistent across the two periods. Magnitude: consistent, stronger in validation.
leakage_check: candle-level fields; garbled-future test passes; effect sizes small for direction, moderate for magnitude (as expected: activity clusters like volatility)
overfitting_suspected: no -- nothing fitted; the direction result contradicts the pre-stated hypothesis, which is not what fitting produces
affected_design: (1) Add trades_rel_168h as a candidate input for the Phase 11 uncertainty model (with tr_mean_14_rel and hour-of-day); test incremental value then. (2) The short-horizon reversal family (momentum, volume, taker-buy share at 1-6h) is now the only consistent directional pattern in the data; Phase 9 will test whether a fitted, regularised model combining these weak inputs beats baselines out-of-sample under walk-forward validation -- one pre-registered experiment, not a search.
notes: Roadmap correction recorded: 8.7 was expected UNAVAILABLE; candle-level aggregates made a clean test possible.
